apps_note: Truth lives in image/apps.conf; launch.sh replaces __TITLE__ with a unique per-instance marker so xdotool can discover each window. v1.0.0 maps entries to reliably-discoverable titled xterms. WHICH app a runtime runs is RUNTIME DATA, not contract: a richer browser is a new runtime version, never a contract change.
